intro_html: Smoky North African harissa chicken with a lime tahini yogurt sauce, rice, sweet peas, crunchy cucumber, and feta. Every bowl hits 43 grams of protein for about $3.79 (at everyday cost). Spicy, creamy, cold-crunchy, and priced like it came off the clearance rack.
cost_closing_html: About $3.79 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a harissa bowl the Mediterranean chains sell for $14. The chicken breast here cost about $3.79 a pound, which is the real headline.
shop_smart: Chicken breast at $8.20 for 3.75 lb is one of the cheapest proteins on our whole grocery board. When breast dips near $2 a pound, this is the recipe to run.
The harissa jar looks pricey, but $4.13 of paste seasons all 14 bowls, about 30 cents each, and the jar keeps for months.
Feta is the biggest splurge at $4.86. Crumble a block yourself, or halve it and let the tahini yogurt sauce carry the richness.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice: rinse, simmer covered with water until tender, and set aside.
Cube the chicken breast and toss it with the harissa paste, a third of the lime juice, salt, garlic powder, cumin, and onion powder.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet in batches, 6 to 8 minutes per batch, until it reaches 165F inside. Crowding the pan steams it, so give it room.
Whisk the tahini, Greek yogurt, remaining lime juice, and a splash of water into a pourable sauce. Season with salt.
Warm the frozen peas, and dice the cucumber and red onion.
Portion rice into 14 containers, add chicken and peas, then top with cucumber, red onion, feta, and the tahini sauce kept to one side.
portion_html: Weigh the rice pot and the cooked chicken, subtract the empty pot number, and divide each by 14 so every container gets an even share. Each bowl comes out to about 571 calories and 43 grams of protein.

steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Toss cubed chicken with harissa, lime, and spices, then sear in batches to 165F.
Whisk tahini, Greek yogurt, lime juice, and water into a sauce.
Portion rice, chicken, and peas into 14 containers; top with cucumber, red onion, feta, and sauce.
